newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says can only watch stock price moves.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says can only watch stock price moves.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) can only watch movements of stock prices closely and calmly, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday.
"We will watch the current stock prices calmly with deep interest. That is the best we can do," Mitsuzuka said.
He also said the stock market was affected by many factors at present, not only by economic fundamentals.
"If you ask me whether the stock market is reflecting the fundamentals of the economy, I don't think that is all (that's affecting it)," he said.
Mitsuzuka reiterated his view that the Japanese economy was gaining firmness as shown by various government economic indicators.
